body: From the [implementation](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/7b4d733593842361d066d7e33a03a07da5dca465/tensorflow/core/kernels/conv_grad_ops_3d.cc#L356) it looks like the `input` tensor is only used for shape information, so your dummy tensor approach should work fine.
We should aim for parity with conv2d then.
